[LCON.2.4.1] Runtimes may use hash tables, heaps, or other
unordered data structures internally. When run with
the engine configured to reverse hash iteration order
(if the implementation exposes that configuration),
outputs must still match bit-for-bit.

idris.name: ldet_5_9__dense_refuted
idris.note: Under the dense reading, reversing memory iteration reverses one rule's same-event order, so output would not match bit-for-bit; the model's key is independent of iteration.
